#### Tutorials

This page will collect tutorials on specific topics. If you have a tutorial you would like to share, please contact us, and we will add a link here.

-   A Tutorial for Understanding SEM using R: Where Do All the Numbers Come
From? Published paper by Yves Rosseel and Marc Vidal in the British Journal of Mathematical and Statistical Psychology (2025): [Open Access](https://bpspsychub.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/bmsp.70003).


-   The Pairwise Likelihood Method for Structural Equation Modelling with ordinal variables and data with missing values using the R package lavaan: [PDF file](https://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/pml/PL_Tutorial.pdf), [Dataset](https://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/pml/ESS5Police.RData), [Tutorial_Rcommands.R](https://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/pml/Tutorial_Rcommands.R). Prepared by Myrsini Katsikatsou (formerly from the [LSE](https://www.lse.ac.uk/)). Read also these notes: [Readme.txt](https://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/pml/README.TXT).

-  How to evaluate theory-based hypotheses in a lavaan model using
the GORICA: [PDF file](https://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/goric/Tutorial_GORIC_restriktor_lavaan.pdf), [HTML file](https://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/goric/Tutorial_GORIC_restriktor_lavaan.html). Prepared by [Rebecca Kuiper](https://www.uu.nl/staff/RMKuiper) from [Utrecht University](https://www.uu.nl/staff/organisationalchart/fsw/56/278).
